description: Feedback system and Production Passport API. Implement POST /api/project-messages (comments, revision requests, scope changes with delivery/timestamp attachments), GET /api/project-messages, POST /api/deliveries/[id]/approve (brand final approval with technical failure override), GET /api/passport/[agreementId] (complete project history), POST /api/reviews (one per agreement, brand only). All routes enforce participant-only access.
steps: Create app/api/project-messages/route.ts POST: (1) Verify authenticated user. (2) Parse body: {agreementId, messageType: 'comment'|'revision_request'|'scope_change_request', content, deliveryVersion?, videoTimestampSeconds?, proposedChanges?}. (3) Fetch agreement, verify user is participant (creator or brand). (4) Validate: content required, deliveryVersion valid if provided (exists in deliveries table), proposedChanges valid JSONB for scope_change_request. (5) Insert project_message with sender_id=user.id, change_accepted_by_creator=false, change_accepted_by_brand=false. (6) If messageType='scope_change_request', also create scope_changes row with previous_version=agreement.version, new_version=version+1, extract price_delta and deadline_delta_days from proposedChanges. (7) Return 201 with message object.

Create app/api/project-messages/route.ts GET: Query param agreementId required. Verify user is participant. Return messages array ordered by created_at ASC (chronological). Include sender name/role by joining users table.

Create app/api/deliveries/[id]/approve/route.ts POST: (1) Verify authenticated user. (2) Fetch delivery with agreement, verify user is brand (not creator - only brand approves). (3) Check delivery.inspection_status - if 'fail' AND no body.overrideReason provided, return 400 'Cannot approve failed delivery without override reason'. (4) Parse body: {approvalNotes?, overrideReason?}. (5) Update delivery: brand_approved_at=NOW(), approval_notes=approvalNotes||overrideReason. (6) Check if this is the final deliverable (version >= agreement.deliverables.quantity) - if yes, update brief status='Delivered'. (7) Return 200 with updated delivery.

Create app/api/passport/[agreementId]/route.ts GET: (1) Verify authenticated user. (2) Fetch agreement with joins: original brief (select campaign_title, objective, content_type, aspect_ratios, budget_min, budget_max, deadline, commercial_use), original proposal (select message, price, timeline_days, creator info), all deliveries with inspection_results and approval timestamps, all project_messages with sender names, all scope_changes with acceptance timestamps. (3) Verify user is participant. (4) Build history timeline array: [{type: 'brief_created', timestamp: brief.createdAt, data: brief}, {type: 'proposal_accepted', timestamp: proposal.updatedAt, data: proposal}, {type: 'agreement_created', timestamp: agreement.createdAt, data: {version, price, milestones}}, {type: 'creator_accepted', timestamp: agreement.creatorAcceptedAt}, {type: 'brand_accepted', timestamp: agreement.brandAcceptedAt}, {type: 'delivery_uploaded', timestamp: delivery.createdAt, data: delivery}, {type: 'message', timestamp: message.createdAt, data: message}, {type: 'scope_change', timestamp: scopeChange.createdAt, data: scopeChange}, {type: 'final_approval', timestamp: delivery.brandApprovedAt, data: approvalNotes}]. Sort by timestamp. (5) Return {agreement, brief, proposal, deliveries, messages, scopeChanges, history, review?}.

Update app/api/reviews/route.ts POST: (1) Add validation: check agreementId in body. (2) Fetch agreement, verify user is brand. (3) Check agreement is complete (has final approved delivery). (4) Check no existing review for this agreement: SELECT FROM reviews WHERE agreement_id=X. (5) If exists, return 400 'Review already submitted'. (6) Insert review linking agreement_id. (7) Update creator_profiles stats: increment projectsCompleted, recalculate avgRating. (8) Return 201.

Update types/index.ts: Add AgreementStatus type ('draft'|'pending_creator'|'pending_brand'|'active'|'completed'), PassportEvent type {type: string, timestamp: string, data: any}, ProductionPassport type {agreement: Agreement, brief: Brief, proposal: Proposal, deliveries: Delivery[], messages: ProjectMessage[], scopeChanges: any[], history: PassportEvent[], review?: any}. Update BriefStatus to include 'In Production'. Update Review interface to include optional agreementId field.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/project-messages creates comment messages with participant verification, allows delivery version and video timestamp attachments
POST /api/project-messages with messageType='scope_change_request' also creates scope_changes row with extracted price/deadline deltas from proposedChanges
GET /api/project-messages returns chronological messages with sender names, only accessible to participants
POST /api/deliveries/[id]/approve only allows brand user, blocks approval of failed deliveries without override reason, updates brief status to 'Delivered' when final deliverable approved
GET /api/passport/[agreementId] returns complete history with all events sorted by timestamp, only accessible to participants, includes original brief and proposal data
Updated POST /api/reviews validates agreement completion, prevents duplicate reviews per agreement, updates creator stats
All routes return 401/403/404 correctly based on authentication and ownership checks
verification: Build check: npm run build. Expect 0 TypeScript errors.

Test POST /api/project-messages with messageType='comment': Use Postman with valid session, agreementId from FEAT-002 test, content='Looks great!'. Expect 201. Verify in database: SELECT * FROM project_messages WHERE agreement_id='<id>'. Expect 1 row with message_type='comment'.
Test POST /api/project-messages with messageType='revision_request': Include deliveryVersion=1, content='Please adjust color grading'. Verify message created with delivery_version=1.

Test POST /api/project-messages with messageType='scope_change_request': Include proposedChanges={priceDelta: 500, deadlineDeltaDays: 3, changes: 'Add 5 extra seconds'}. Verify both project_messages row AND scope_changes row created. Check scope_changes has price_delta=500, deadline_delta_days=3.
Test GET /api/project-messages: Expect array with all messages, ordered chronologically. Verify non-participant gets 403.

Test POST /api/deliveries/[id]/approve with failed delivery, no overrideReason: Expect 400 error. Test again with overrideReason='Client requested despite format mismatch'. Expect 200, verify brand_approved_at set, approval_notes contains override reason.

Test GET /api/passport/[agreementId]: Expect full history object with nested brief/proposal/deliveries/messages. Verify history array sorted by timestamp, contains events like 'brief_created', 'delivery_uploaded', 'final_approval'. Check non-participant gets 403.

Test POST /api/reviews with agreementId: Verify review created, linked to agreement. Try duplicate review, expect 400. Verify creator stats updated: SELECT stats FROM creator_profiles WHERE id='<creatorId>'. Check projectsCompleted incremented, avgRating updated.
